system.name: Charon
system.one_liner: background on LLMs, their training / inference workflows, parallelism strategies, and the cost of profiling-based tuning

flows.what: inference stages sharing the KV cache

content.key_idea: LLM execution has many parallelism knobs, so profiling-based tuning on a large cluster explodes in GPU hours and design-space size.
content.reading_order: (a) top: stack on the left, zoom to the block on the right; (b) middle: training and inference steps on the left, the parallelism catalogue on the right; (c) bottom: the tuning loop on the left, its cost chart on the right.

palette.used_for: embedding / LM head / KV cache / initial configuration boxes
transformer blocks, prefill / decode stages, forward weights
key generation, backward error, pipeline layer 1, profiling experiments
norm layers, expected output, input sequence, optimized configuration
forward step text and GPU-hour bars

style.stroke: dark ink ~0.65 pt on boxes; black ~1.3 pt panel frames; dash-dot dividers inside panels; dotted outlines for omitted / optional parts (grouped-query copies, inactive expert)
style.font: Calibri Bold throughout, rotated labels on tall bars, about 5-6 pt at print size
style.arrows: short black arrows; coloured arrows only for forward (blue), backward (red), update (green)
style.icons: GPU-card outlines, people icon, circular update arrow

encoding.color_means: one fill per concept reused across panels; step colours (blue forward, red backward, green update) repeated in text, arrows and the circled step labels
encoding.line_style_means: dotted outlines = optional or replicated parts; dash-dot = panel subdivision
encoding.emphasis: thick black frames and bold panel letters structure the figure; no single accent
reusable_patterns: tall background figure as three framed bands, each split by a dash-dot rule into diagram + companion
parallelism catalogue: one mini diagram per strategy over the same two GPU-card icons
rotated text inside tall bars as stage dividers and as input/output bookends
weaknesses: at 228 pt wide the parallelism labels print at about 5 pt, below the 6 pt floor
panel (c) mixes a data chart into the diagram

evidence: Modern LLMs are based on a decoder-only transformer architecture
shows the most widely used parallelism strategies
conventional tuning workflow typically follows an iterative profile-analyze-tune way

summary: A three-band background figure. (a) A decoder-only stack whose Transformer block is zoomed into norm, Q/K/V generation, multi-head and grouped-query attention, residual adds and a feed-forward / MoE layer. (b) Training (forward, backward, update) and inference (prefill, decode, KV cache) steps beside a catalogue of TP, DP, EP, PP and SP mini diagrams over two GPU cards. (c) The profiling-based tuning loop beside a chart of GPU hours and design-space size growing with each added choice.
summary_zh: 背景图，三个粗黑框面板竖排：(a) 解码器堆栈，放大其中一个 Transformer 块；(b) 训练和推理的步骤，旁边是五种并行策略的小图；(c) 实测调参的循环和它的成本曲线。
notes: Style reference for the named style 'charon'; printed in a single column, so its smallest labels fall below 6 pt -- copy the structure, not the type size.
